title: Spheres entering the water at Guadalupe Island

tellings.quote: uh Lou Alzando and I think Sean Cahill went down to Guadalupe Island because there have been reports of

plain: Around 2019, two men named Luis Elizondo and Sean Cahill went to Guadalupe Island, off Mexico, because there had been reports of spheres flying into the water there. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff tells it, linking the trip to a National Geographic television series called Unidentified. If true, it would point to unknown objects that move between the air and the sea.
